customManagers.description: Track the vendored projects that vendor/vendor.toml pins by release.
Track the cwrap release that CI and the Linux image install.

packageRules.description: A vendored release needs its sources replaced, so its update is a reminder, never merged as is.
prBodyNotes: This updates only the release in `vendor/vendor.toml`. Before merging, run `vendor/vendor.py sync {{{depName}}}`, which replaces the sources under `vendor/` with that release and records its commit in the manifest and the notices. For a tree-sitter grammar, it also prints the upstream changes to the query files, to port to `libs/src/markup/queries/`. The Vendored sources job fails until the sources match the release.
